title: The meta-schema of a RecordType's schema
$comment: A RecordType's schema is a JSON Schema 2020-12 object that may also hold SpecSheriff's own keywords, identifierOf and enumSource, declared in SpecSheriff's own vocabulary (s-j4t9vusnsajmqdw). `$vocabulary` sets that vocabulary to false, which marks it as optional, so a JSON Schema tool that does not know it still processes the schema. The $dynamicAnchor makes the meta-schema of JSON Schema 2020-12 apply this meta-schema to every schema within a RecordType's schema, at any depth.

recordtype.$comment: SpecSheriff's own keywords, checked in each schema within a RecordType's schema. A field's values come from one source only (s-xfu2gpzddjnmgks): its own enum, each value in it once, or the source that its enumSource names. A field never has both.

identifierOf.$comment: The sid of the RecordType whose data records the field identifies; the field takes the type of the field that identifies them (s-4npdup7mjkva69y, s-3anv9qcmx8pwp2w).

enumSource.$comment: Where a field's values come from when they are not its own list, and the values gathered from that source (s-5nf87c3e3jg9v7c). from parts: the names of the parts into which the base specification is divided (s-gqavjzcmubg5pvk). from kind: the sids of the nodes of the base specification whose kind is the project's own kind that the key kind names (s-mt6auv3jz8m5gzh). gathered: each value with the sid of the node it comes from, written only by the SpecSheriff tools (s-ju5vcanbjph7mgh).
